findings_corrected: Cleanup retry no longer tries to restore Deployments already deleted after a durable full-process cleanup checkpoint.
The pre-protection path requires exact still-running original identities and absent markers, with a distinct cleanup-only proof mode.
PVC deletion uses the same binding observation UID/resourceVersion; new bindings and claim-UID volume census remain separately verified.
An empty claim-UID census cannot settle external CSI provisioning; unproven allocations retain state/namespace and block storage certification and database cleanup.

independent_review.scope: Read-only source and regression review; no tests executed by reviewer.
independent_review.result: No remaining material blocker found in reviewed correction.

limitations: Unit tests use simulated Kubernetes resources and do not establish actual kubelet/PVC behavior.
Partial protection without complete original exit proof requires reconciliation.
Allocation acknowledgment loss before recorded UID still fails closed.
No runtime image, canonical migration, production adapter or root worktree file changed.
Unbound or missing PVC without a proven PV identity requires allocation reconciliation; an empty census is insufficient.
